# Pi Skill E2E

Follow these instructions exactly.

If the user message includes `explicit-skill-case`, reply with exactly:

PI_SKILL_EXPLICIT_OK

If the user message asks for the automatic skill invocation case, reply with exactly:

PI_SKILL_AUTO_OK

Do not add any other words.
